<script>
  // Which hero engine runs. The default is now the fixed-tick engine under
  // assets/pandas/engine/ — the Phase-A rewrite — which passed the character gate

  (function () {

      var css = document.createElement('link');
      css.rel = 'stylesheet';
      css.href = 'assets/pandas/engine/render/pandas.css';
      document.head.appendChild(css);
      var mod = document.createElement('script');
      mod.type = 'module';
      mod.src = 'assets/pandas/engine/render/site.js';
      document.head.appendChild(mod);
    } else {
      var legacy = document.createElement('script');
      legacy.src = 'assets/pandas/pandas.js';
      legacy.defer = true;
      document.head.appendChild(legacy);
    }
  })();
</script>
